baselines.name: Original USA (Retail ACVE)
baselines.author: Konami (Retail USA ACVE)
baselines.summary: Clean USA retail baseline. Import any community mod or translation locally via F1 -> Mods without modifying your ROM.

baselines.name: Optional Local Baseline Patch
baselines.author: User local patch
baselines.summary: Optional user-supplied baseline patch slot ({data}/mods/definitive/); remains inactive unless you provide your own local patch files.

campaigns.name: Dawn of Sorrow (Main Campaign)
campaigns.author: Konami (Retail USA ACVE)
campaigns.summary: Standard Dawn of Sorrow campaign. Additional local mods (.xdelta / .ips / .dospatch) imported via F1 -> Mods or placed in {data}/mods/profiles/ are discovered automatically without modifying your ROM.

campaigns.name: Tradução PT-BR (Definitive Edition)
campaigns.author: Hyllian, Solid One, Neko Belmont, Mysterioso, denim, djmatheusito, victoriemini
campaigns.summary: Authorized Brazilian Portuguese v1.1 translation + Definitive Edition all-in-one (authorized by @leomontenegro6 in cdos-traducao-ptbr#1) — manual import only (zero files bundled). Download cdos_de_1.1.xdelta from the official release and click 'Patch...'.

campaigns.name: Definitive Edition+
campaigns.author: Masked Dedede, DevAnj, Thirteen 1355, ShadowOne333, acediez, LagoLunatic
campaigns.summary: Community QoL & visual overhaul (Dawn of Dignity portraits, Fixed Luck, No Required Touch, Definitive Mode) — manual import only (zero files bundled). Download directly from Romhacking.net and click 'Patch...'.

campaigns.name: Eternity of Sorrow
campaigns.author: Wet-Band-Aid
campaigns.summary: Full-game sequel campaign authorized by @Wet-Band-Aid (Issue #44). No mod files are bundled or downloaded; download the official .xdelta from the creator and click 'Patch...'.

campaigns.name: Alucard's Requiem (SOTN Variant)
campaigns.author: DarkPrinceAlucard, Drameloch
campaigns.summary: Alucard campaign overhaul (Symphony of the Night appearance) — manual import only (zero files bundled). Download directly from the creator's release thread and click 'Patch...'.

campaigns.name: Alucard's Requiem (CV3 Variant)
campaigns.author: DarkPrinceAlucard, I am Me
campaigns.summary: Alucard campaign overhaul (Castlevania III appearance) — manual import only (zero files bundled). Download directly from the creator's release thread and click 'Patch...'.

campaigns.name: Dracula's Curse (Trevor Mode)
campaigns.author: Fat T-800 (Albert Edvard)
campaigns.summary: Julius Mode overhaul starring Trevor Belmont, Sypha Belnades, Grant Danasty, and Alucard — manual import only (zero files bundled). Download from Romhacking.net and click 'Patch...'.

character_packs.name: Native Cast (Soma / Julius / Yoko / Alucard)
character_packs.author: Native
character_packs.summary: Uses the active campaign's native playable characters.

addons.name: Tradução PT-BR (Vanilla)
addons.author: Hyllian, Solid One, Neko Belmont, Mysterioso, denim, djmatheusito, victoriemini
addons.summary: Authorized Brazilian Portuguese v1.1 translation (Vanilla, authorized by @leomontenegro6 in cdos-traducao-ptbr#1) — modular & stackable with QoL/visual/audio add-ons below via 3-way in-memory merge! Zero files bundled; download cdos_1.1.xdelta and click 'Patch...'.

addons.name: Dawn of Dignity (Gothic Portraits)
addons.author: ShadowOne333, acediez
addons.summary: Replaces anime-style character portraits with gothic Ayami Kojima-inspired artwork matching Aria of Sorrow — modular & stackable with PT-BR and other add-ons. Zero files bundled; download from Romhacking.net #3356 and click 'Patch...'.

addons.name: No Required Touch Screen (No Magic Seals)
addons.author: LagoLunatic
addons.summary: Removes forced touch mechanics: auto-completes boss Magic Seals, skips name-signing, and allows smashing ice blocks with melee attacks — modular & stackable with PT-BR and other add-ons. Download from Romhacking.net #3408 and click 'Patch...'.

addons.name: Fixed Luck
addons.author: LagoLunatic
addons.summary: Fixes the bugged Luck stat calculation so Luck meaningfully improves soul and item drop rates — modular & stackable with PT-BR and other add-ons. Download from Romhacking.net #3407 and click 'Patch...'.

addons.name: Voice Restore Project
addons.author: Community (Romhacking.net #10040)
addons.summary: Restores original voice clips in Dawn of Sorrow — modular & stackable with PT-BR and other add-ons. Zero files bundled; download from Romhacking.net #10040 and click 'Patch...'.
